# Project API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

Groups the subjects, sessions and specimens of a study and sets who can see and edit them.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/project/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/stem/project/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `project` (detail, create, update), `projects` (list)
- **Permissions:** object permissions on the record itself (member / manager / owner roles)
- **Uniqueness:** `name` unique across BrainSTEM
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`breeding`](/api/stem/breeding/), [`cohort`](/api/stem/cohort/), [`collection`](/api/stem/collection/), [`projectgroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/stem/projectgroupmembershipinvitation/), [`projectmembershipinvitation`](/api/stem/projectmembershipinvitation/) records

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 200 characters |
| `description` | string; nullable |
| `sessions` | list of [`session`](/api/stem/session/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `subjects` | list of [`subject`](/api/stem/subject/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `publications` | list of [`publication`](/api/dissemination/publication/) ids |
| `extra_fields` | JSON object |
| `is_public` | boolean. Designates if the project is publicly available |
| `collections` | list of [`collection`](/api/stem/collection/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `cohorts` | list of [`cohort`](/api/stem/cohort/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `tags` | list of strings; filter with `filter{tags.name}=<name>` |
| `users` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `groups` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/project/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('project', load_all=True)
records = resp['projects']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('project', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.projects;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "projects": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "name": "Project 1",
            "description": "",
            "sessions": [
                "<session-id>"
            ],
            "subjects": [
                "<subject-id>"
            ],
            "publications": [
                "<publication-id>"
            ],
            "extra_fields": {},
            "is_public": true,
            "collections": [
                "<collection-id>"
            ],
            "cohorts": [
                "<cohort-id>"
            ],
            "tags": [],
            "users": null,
            "groups": null,
            "user": "<user-id>"
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/project/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('project', data={"name": "Project 1"})
record = resp.json()['project']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Project 1'), 'project');
record = created.project;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/project/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('project', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['project']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab

record = out.project;
```

```json
        "is_public": true,

            "<collection-id>"
        ],
        "cohorts": [
            "<cohort-id>"
        ],

        "user": "<user-id>"
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/project/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('project', id='<id>', data={"name": "Project 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Project 1 (renamed)'), 'project', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/project/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('project', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'project');
```

## Custom actions

| Action | Request |
|:-------|:--------|
| `export` | GET, POST `/api/private/stem/project/<id>/export/` |
| `export_jobs` | GET `/api/private/stem/project/<id>/export-jobs/` |
| `export_job` | GET `/api/private/stem/project/<id>/export-jobs/<job_id>/` |
| `export_job_download` | GET `/api/private/stem/project/<id>/export-jobs/<job_id>/download/` |
| `leave` | POST `/api/private/stem/project/<id>/leave/` |

`export` returns the project as versioned JSON (see [Exports](/api/export/)); `POST` starts a background export job, `export-jobs` lists your jobs for the project and `export-jobs/<job_id>/download/` fetches the finished file.

## JSON field schemas

Schemas for the additional fields and repository links of a project. The REST API returns these JSON fields as stored and validates writes against the schemas below. Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Project/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; see [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).

### Additional fields

- type code `Array` · version 1.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Project/Array/1.0.1.json)

Any extra parameters you want to add to this project. Saved as key-value pairs. Values can be strings or numbers.

| Property | Description |
|:---------|:------------|
| `key` | text |
| `value` | object |

Illustrative payload:

```json
[
    {
        "key": "text",
        "value": {}
    }
]
```


### Public repositories

- type code `Repository` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Project/Repository/1.0.0.json)

Link to public repositories where data from this project is stored.

| Property | Description |
|:---------|:------------|
| `repository` | choice **[required]**; one of `CRCNS`, `DANDI`, `Figshare`, `GitHub`, `Globus`, `Mendeley`, `Zenodo`, `Webshare`, `Other`; default `"DANDI"` |
| `url` | text **[required]**; format url |

Illustrative payload:

```json
[
    {
        "repository": "CRCNS",
        "url": "text"
    }
]
```


## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Project data model page](/datamodel/stem/project/).

## Usage notes

- `extra_fields` is a JSON object whose keys start with a letter and contain only letters, digits and underscores; values are strings or numbers.
- `users` and `groups` are read-only. To give a person or a group a role on the project, create a [project membership invitation](/api/stem/projectmembershipinvitation/) or a [project group membership invitation](/api/stem/projectgroupmembershipinvitation/). See [Permissions](/datamodel/permissions/) for the roles.
